texts.preamble: M/S K. Kapoor And P.R. Mahant vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Judgement ... on 8 January, 2014 Writ Petition No :: 21753 / 2013 M/s K. Kapoor and others Vs. State of Mp and others 08.01.2014 .
texts.facts: Petitioners are licensed contractors and have been granted contract by the Railway Administration in the matter of carrying out certain business activities by establishing Food Stalls in the Railway Station. They feel aggrieved by notice- dated 26.7.2013 - Annexure P/1, issued by the Chief Health and Food Inspector, Central Railway, Khandwa directing them to get registered and obtain license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. According to the petitioners, the statutory date for obtaining the said license has been extended by the Central Government to 4.2.2014 and, therefore, before 4.2.2014 no coercive steps can be taken against them. It is indicated that the petitioners have already taken steps for obtaining the license and the prayer made is that before 4.2.2014, no action be taken against them.
